walkthrough.short: Take both hands with {pairs}, rock in and out, then swing without letting go.
walkthrough.long: Take both hands with {pairs} and rock: two steps in toward them, two steps back. That is the balance, four beats. Without letting go of the hand you are already holding, close into a ballroom hold and buzz round for the rest of the phrase. Open out side by side, lark on the left. {where}
